_what: Each college's reconcile steps: after extraction, the reading procedure searches the page text again for a figure the record lacks and fills it, naming the words it came from (kb/_program_requirements_reconcile.py). Sam, 2026-10-14: "Seems like our procedure should attempt to close gaps by doing a secondary search of the catalog text to see if we can reconcile after the initial PR harvest" and "we are configuring procedures for each catalog, right. So Cabrillo's procedure might require steps that others do not." (cpl_memory sam-reconcile-pass-after-harvest-2026-10-14). A step fills a field only where the record leaves it empty, and clears one only where a step says which words the reading took it from.

_kinds.fill: pattern's min (and max) fill program.<field> when it is empty; only_without / only_with name a field that must be empty / set; skip_if_equal names a field that already holds the same figure (no double count)
_kinds.clear_minimum: a sentence giving a kind of degree's least units in the major (pattern's n) is no major total: total_units equal to n is cleared, once the record reads a degree total
_kinds.order: steps run in order: a clear runs before the fills that depend on it
_kinds.awards: 'associate': the steps read associate degrees only (a certificate's page prints its own total in the same words); 'transfer': transfer degrees only (AA-T, AS-T), for a figure such as Cal-GETC that a local degree never carries though its captured page may span the sibling transfer section
_kinds.set: a figure the page's words point to, set from the step's value where the field is empty: the catalog prints it once for every degree on its own page (source, source_words) or states a rule the record keeps as a flag (Cerritos's minimum of 60, its electives as needed)
_kinds.prefix_aliases: the college's subject prefixes as its catalog prints them, mapped to the state file's: the scorer reads a placed code the file lists only under the other prefix as that listed course (never one the file lists as printed)
_kinds.course_renumbers: courses the college renumbered after the state's file was written, the catalog's code mapped to the file's, each pair cited by the title and units both print: read wherever prefix_aliases is (the capture's coverage, the scorer, the second reader), and never where the file lists the printed code, so a pair retires once the file catches up

Cabrillo College.why: Sam marked Biology A.S. (06328) Needs a fix on 2026-10-14: "missing the Cabrillo College General Education credits required: 24 and the 6 units of Elective. Both are noted on the catalog." A runner read (college-page-read 38633618089) shows every degree page's requirements tree: "Complete the following number of credits: 60" under the award's title, then "Cabrillo College General Education 24" (or "Cal-GETC General Education 34"), the major, and "General electives: any transferable or degree applicable course. 6". Its prose says "at least 30 units in the major", which the reading took for the major total.

steps.pattern: at least (?P<n>\d+) units in the major
General electives: any transferable or degree applicable course\.?\s*(?P<min>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)
General electives: any transferable or degree applicable course\.?\s*(?P<min>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)

Cerritos College.why: All 148 of Cerritos's associate-degree records held the major only (S393). Every degree page prints the major's own total and then "Complete a minimum of 60 units to include (1) the above major requirements, (2) the General Education requirements, and (3) electives as needed" (college-page-read 38654411937, Biology A.A. and Automotive Technology: General Technician A.S.). The catalog's CGEC page states the general education: "To earn a local associate degree, a minimum of 60 degree-applicable units must be completed ... comprised of specific courses for a major, general education (GE), and electives as needed. CGEC, which is 24-28 units, is intended to meet the GE requirements" (read 38656043692; majors of 32 units or more are exempt from Areas 8 and 9, which is the 24). The major total is right as read, so no step clears it.

steps.pattern: Complete a minimum of (?P<min>\d+(?:\.\d+)?) units to include \(1\) the above major requirements
Complete a minimum of \d+(?:\.\d+)? units to include \(1\) the above major requirements

steps.source_words: CGEC, which is 24-28 units, is intended to meet the GE requirements.

Orange Coast College.why: Orange Coast's degree pages print their totals on the REQUIREMENTS tab, which the reading took the major from and often left the rest of (S395: 41 associate-degree records named the degree total and the OCC AS GE pattern but no units for it). College page read 38752570705 (Management and Leadership Studies A.S., 03961, and Accounting A.S.) reads the tab's textContent: "Total Major Units36 - 37 OCC AS General Education 1,2up to 21 Transferable electives as needed to satisfy unit requirementsvaries Total Minimum Degree Units - OCC AS GE60", footnote 1 "Some program major units may also meet GE requirements" and footnote 2 "Cal-GETC pattern (up to 34 units) may be substituted". So the 60 is a minimum and electives make it up. "Up to 21" is a maximum: a major course may also meet GE, so the step sets the GE units' max to 21 and leaves its min unstated (the scorer reads the span as 21, the most the pattern asks, and the electives make up the rest of the 60). S396 SkyJacaranda, 2026-10-16.

steps.pattern: Total Minimum Degree Units\s*-\s*OCC AS GE\s*(?P<min>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)
Total Minimum Degree Units\s*-\s*OCC AS GE\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?
Transferable electives as needed to satisfy unit requirements

Monterey Peninsula College.why: Sixty-five of Monterey Peninsula's associate-degree records name the 60 and a GE pattern with no units for it (S395): 42 "MPC General Education or Cal-GETC", 23 Cal-GETC alone. A local degree page prints "Complete Competency Requirements, general education pattern (MPC General Education or Cal-GETC), and electives, if needed, for a total of 60 degree-applicable units" and no GE units (college page read 38749721270, Horticulture A.S.); a transfer degree page prints "Certified completion of the California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) pattern" (read 38843693844, Psychology AA-T). The catalog's GE page (read 38759288106) says Cal-GETC "satisfies the 34 units of lower-division general education" and lists MPC GE as eight areas (1A, 1B, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7), each "Select three units" (1A one 3-unit course), with no total. So a local degree's GE is 24 to 34: the least the MPC GE areas ask, eight times three, and Cal-GETC's 34. The 24 is a sum of the page's own figures, which the page does not print; S396 SkyJacaranda, 2026-10-16, proceeded on it and put it to Sam as a card.

steps.pattern: [Gg]eneral education pattern \(MPC General Education or Cal-GETC\)
steps.source_words: MPC GE: Area 1A ENGL C1000 3; Areas 1B, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7, each "Select three units from the following." Cal-GETC: "satisfies the 34 units of lower-division general education requirements"

steps.pattern: Certified completion of the California General Education Transfer Curriculum \(Cal-GETC\) pattern
steps.source_words: Completion of this pattern satisfies the 34 units of lower-division general education requirements for transfer to any CSU or UC campus as well as the general education requirements for the Associate Degree for Transfer (AA-T, AS-T)

Taft College.why: Eleven of Taft's transfer-degree records add up their major and fail the degree check as incomplete: the page prints "Total Credit Hours: 24", "Option 1: CSU/UC - Completion of the California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) is required", "Additional transferable elective units may be used to reach the required 60 units" and "Total Credit Hours: 60", and no units for Cal-GETC (college-page-read 39122581817, Early Childhood Education AS-T). Taft's own Cal-GETC page prints none either (same read). Cal-GETC is one statewide pattern of 34 semester units; the figure is cited from Monterey Peninsula's GE page (read 38759288106), as Monterey's step reads it, and San Joaquin Delta's degree pages print the same 34 (read 39122473643). S415 SkyRedbud proceeded on it on Fable's advice (option A of three: the narrowest fix, in the college's procedure, reversible by deleting this step) and put it to Sam as a card.

steps.source_words: Completion of this pattern satisfies the 34 units of lower-division general education requirements for transfer to any CSU or UC campus as well as the general education requirements for the Associate Degree for Transfer (AA-T, AS-T)

San Joaquin Delta College.why: San Joaquin Delta's reconcile (run 39116289105) read 28 associate degrees that pass their major total as failing the degree total under record shape 6: an 18-unit major and general education 27-34 against 60, or a 59.5-unit major past the 77.5 printed. Every degree page prints "Minimum Major Units Required: N", the general education patterns ("San Joaquin Delta College Associate Degree General Education Pattern Units: 27", "Cal-GETC ... Units: 34"), "Students are advised to double-count courses in the major to also satisfy general education when possible ... the units will only be counted once in computing the total number of units for the degree" and "Minimum Degree Units Required: 60" (college-page-read 39122473643: Engineering Computer-Aided Drafting A.S., Modern Policing A.S., Nursing R.N. A.S., Electron Microscopy A.S.). The degree total is a floor: units short of it come from courses the student chooses, and a sum past it double-counts. The major total is right as read, so no step clears it. A step setting electives_fill_degree from the same words (S415, reconcile 39122702830) turned 15 records whose pages name no electives to failing under the scorer's electives check; the scorer now reads a floor alone as letting units the student chooses make up a short sum, so the step was dropped. S422 SkyWillow, 2026-10-19: the Jev sitting of run 39206690775's verdicts (kb/jev_harvest_verdicts/san_joaquin_delta.json) read 29 of 35 unequal records as one shape: every program page prints its total as a floor ("Minimum Units Required: N" on a certificate, "Minimum Major Units Required: N" on a degree) and the record's sum is a range whose low end equals it (a one-unit alternative such as ENGL C1000E 4 beside ENGL C1000 3, a block printed as a range, a variable-unit course). The third step marks the program total a floor on every award, and the scorer passes a sum whose low end meets it. The college-wide awards filter moved onto the two degree-total steps. Its catalog prints five subjects under another prefix than the state's file keeps (ANTH 2L for ANTHR 2L, ENGL 35 for ENG 35, ARTH 2 for ART 2, COMM 7 for COM ST 7; same number and title, the readers' notes on 18815, 31692, 32341, 32913, 37638 and 40824), so prefix_aliases names them for the scorer, which renames a placed code only where the file lists it under the other prefix and not as printed.

Cañada College.why: Five of Cañada's transfer-degree records (Mathematics 30741, Geography 32295, Child and Adolescent Development 35834, Social Work and Human Services 37122, Communication Studies 2.0 43478) name the degree total of 60 and the Cal-GETC pattern and print no units for it, so the degree check reads them incomplete; the Jev sitting of run 39197675380 named stated_total_counts_more for all five (kb/jev_harvest_verdicts/ca_ada.json). Every Cal-GETC transfer page in the catalog closes its requirements block with 'Completion of Cal-GETC (California General Education Transfer Curriculum)' and then 'Elective courses: Additional CSU or UC transferable courses needed to meet the minimum 60 CSU transferable unit requirement' (college page reads 39198670828, 39199041273, 39199607253; eight sections printed, Business Administration 2.0, Communication Studies 2.0, Computer Science, Economics, Child and Adolescent Development, Early Childhood Education, Geography and one more), and the catalog's own general education page states 'California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) - 34 units minimum' and 'Canada local general education pattern - 25 units minimum' (page 79 of the hand-filed 2026-27 PDF). So the figure is Cañada's own, where Taft's step cites Monterey Peninsula's page. Environmental Science AS-T prints CSU-GE Breadth for STEM 33 or IGETC for STEM 31 instead and never matches. S421 SkyTupelo, 2026-10-19, under Sam's go of 2026-10-17 (harvest calls proceed on their procedures without a card). The first reconcile run (39200870107) filled six local A.A./A.S. records too, their captured pages spanning the sibling transfer section, and Earth Science A.S. 30427 failed on it (64 past 60): the step reads transfer degrees only.

steps.source_words: California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) - 34 units minimum
